Simulate multinomial-logit (optionally inflated) choice data

Source: R/simulate.R
rmnl.Rd

Draws a data set from the model of mnl() / imnl(): standard normal case-specific covariates x1, x2, ... (or those supplied in x), alternative-specific coefficients beta with the first level as the base, optionally alternative-specific covariates w1, w2, ... with generic coefficients gamma, and, when delta is given, a split equation on z1, z2, ... (or z) that puts cases in the captive regime, where they always choose the inflated alternative.

Usage

rmnl(
  n,
  beta,
  delta = NULL,
  inflate = NULL,
  link = c("logit", "probit"),
  gamma = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  z = NULL,
  levels = NULL
)

Arguments

n

Number of cases.

beta

A \(p \times (J-1)\) matrix: rows are the intercept and the \(p - 1\) covariates, columns the non-base alternatives (column names become their labels; the base is "a" unless levels is given).

delta

Optional split-equation coefficients (intercept first) on z; NULL for a plain MNL. With several inflated alternatives, a matrix with one column per inflated alternative: the coefficients of \(\log(\pi_{i0} / \pi_{ic})\), the log-odds of the choice regime against captivity to that alternative (see imnl()).

inflate

The inflated alternative (a label); default the base. Several labels draw several captive alternatives (logit split only); the output then also has the column regime ("choice" or the captive alternative).

link

Link of the split equation.

gamma

Optional generic coefficients on alternative-specific covariates w1, w2, ... (standard normal draws for every case and alternative). When given, the data are returned in the long layout: one row per case and alternative with columns id, alt, chosen (0/1), the w's, the x's (and, for inflated draws of rmnl(), the z's and s), ready for chosen ~ w1 | x1 + x2 with id = "id", alt = "alt".

x

Optional data frame of case-specific covariates (n rows) to use instead of standard normal draws.

z

Optional data frame of split-equation covariates (n rows) to use instead of standard normal draws.

levels

Optional labels of all \(J\) alternatives (base first).

Value

A data frame: in the wide layout y (factor) and the covariates, plus the latent regime s (1 = choice regime) for inflated draws; in the long layout as described under gamma. The true parameters are stored in the attribute "truth".

See also

mnl(), imnl(), simulate.choicemodel()

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- rmnl(1000, beta = cbind(b = c(0.2, -1, 0.5), c = c(-0.5, 0.8, -0.3)))
table(d$y)
#> 
#>   a   b   c 
#> 286 445 269 
di <- rmnl(1000, beta = cbind(b = c(0.2, -1, 0.5), c = c(-0.5, 0.8, -0.3)),
           delta = c(0.5, 1), inflate = "a")
table(di$y, di$s)
#>    
#>       0   1
#>   a 390 175
#>   b   0 270
#>   c   0 165
dl <- rmnl(500, beta = cbind(b = c(0.2, -1, 0.5), c = c(-0.5, 0.8, -0.3)), gamma = 0.8)
head(dl)
#>   id alt chosen          w1         x1         x2
#> 1  1   a      0 -0.79480342  0.8871888 -1.3254177
#> 2  1   b      0  0.26370340  0.8871888 -1.3254177
#> 3  1   c      1  0.99010104  0.8871888 -1.3254177
#> 4  2   a      1  0.60608460 -0.3776280  0.9519797
#> 5  2   b      0 -0.82945185 -0.3776280  0.9519797
#> 6  2   c      0 -0.06643542 -0.3776280  0.9519797
